# Konza Environmental Education Program (KEEP)

> > KEEP provides K-12 environmental education programs and field trips to Konza Prairie Biological Station, a tallgrass prairie research site managed by Kansas State University.

KEEP connects students and educators with the Flint Hills tallgrass prairie ecosystem through hands-on field experiences, volunteer docent programs, and NGSS-aligned curricula. The site features extensive prairie ecology resources including phenology data, species inventories, and information about fire ecology and bison grazing research at KPBS.

## Key Topics

- Konza Prairie Biological Station (KPBS)
- Tallgrass prairie ecology
- Environmental education and K-12 field trips
- Prairie phenology and seasonal observations
- Fire ecology and prescribed burning
- Bison grazing management
- Wildlife observation and bird sightings
- Docent volunteer program
- Flint Hills ecosystem
- NGSS-aligned curriculum
- Nature trails and visitor access
- Plant and animal species inventories
- Kansas State University research
- Friends of Konza Prairie
- Educational assessment tools

## Getting Started

- [Konza Environmental Education Program](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu): KEEP homepage: K-State tallgrass prairie education & field trips at Konza
- [Visit Konza Prairie](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/visit): Visitor info, hiking trails & directions to Konza Prairie Biological Station
- [Educational Opportunities](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/education): KEEP educational programs & field trips for K-State Konza Prairie visits
- [Reservation Policy and Program Fees](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/education/reservations.html): KEEP booking guidelines, field trip fees & reservation policy for groups

## Prairie Ecology Research

- [Fire Ecology](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/prairieecology/fire.html): Prescribed burning treatments & fire ecology at Konza Prairie tallgrass
- [Bison](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/prairieecology/bison.html): KPBS bison herd management, grazing ecology & conservation research
- [KPBS Plants](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/prairieecology/Plants.html): Complete plant species list & bloom timing for Konza Prairie flora
- [Mammals of Konza Prairie](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/prairieecology/mammals.html): Complete mammal species inventory & biodiversity list for Konza Prairie
- [Butterflies](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/prairieecology/butterflies.html): Konza Prairie butterfly checklist & Kansas lepidoptera species inventory

## Educational Curricula

- [Middle School - Prairie Week Curriculum](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/education/Middle-school%20Prairie%20Week%20Curricula.html): NGSS-aligned middle school tallgrass prairie ecology curriculum for KEEP
- [Highschool Storyline Curriculum](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/education/Highschool_Storyline.html): High school prairie ecology curriculum using storyline pedagogy at KPBS
- [Guidelines for School Groups](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/education/guidelines.html): KEEP field trip rules, chaperone requirements & student safety guidelines
- [Online Assessment Links](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/education/Online%20Assessment%20Links.html): Pre-post field trip assessments & student evaluation tools for KEEP

## Volunteer Programs

- [Docents](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/docents): KEEP volunteer docent program for Konza Prairie environmental education
- [Docent Orientation](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/docents/orientation.html): KEEP volunteer docent training & orientation registration at Konza Prairie

## Phenology Data Archives

- [Plant List 2008-2015](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/prairieecology/phenology/Plant%20List%202008%20-%202015.htm): Konza Prairie plant phenology & bloom date records from 2008-2015
- [Animals 2016-2020](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/prairieecology/phenology2023/Animals%202016%20-%202020a.htm): Konza Prairie animal phenology & bird sighting data from 2016-2020
- [Animals 2004-2006](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/prairieecology/phenology/Animal_2004-2006.htm): Konza Prairie wildlife observation & phenology records 2004-2006
- [Plants May 9 2025](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/prairieecology/phenology2025/plants2025/May%209%202025.htm): Konza Prairie plant blooming observations & phenology data, May 9 2025
- [Animals May 9 2025](https://keep.konza.k-state.edu/prairieecology/phenology2025/animals2025/May%209%202025.htm): Bird sightings & wildlife observations at Konza Prairie, May 9 2025
